scope: Finite ErrorException internal eight-slot layout, distinct six-argument constructor and direct reentry, final getSeverity, and finite Throwable array casts. User subclasses and source property access are separate work.
design: The existing private trace array remains the sole backing. ErrorException appends a protected typed severity slot after the seven inherited Exception slots; string, trace and previous retain Exception private declaration IDs.

Constructor arguments are bound in source order, validated in declaration order before writes, and retain receiver/sent-value roots. The callable owner is ErrorException while the inherited property owner is Exception.

A supplied non-null filename writes even if empty and resets a null line to zero; an explicit line accepts any integer. Reentry keeps the allocation trace. getSeverity uses the existing ordered zero-argument getter tasks.
Finite Throwable array casts copy genuine ordered property slots without marking the sealed object row materialized; trace arrays then follow ordinary COW.
